candidate_windows.window_text:
We use Faireseq to train our models. Text student encoders are trained on 32 Tesla V100 GPUs with a learning rate set to $10^{-4}$ , maximum number of tokens by GPU is 1400, and update frequency is set to 4. Speech student encoders are trained on 48 Tesla V100 GPUs for a few days, with same learning rate as text students, maximum number of sentences is set to 32 by GPU. Text decoders are trained with the same configuration as mBART. Speech decoders are trained on 48 Tesla V100 GPUs with a learning rate set to $3 \cdot 10^{-4}$ , maximum number of sentences is set to 32 by GPU and update frequency is set to 4.
